selectedRecords.title: Datasette motor ramp + sense line + record mode

acceptanceCriteria.text: Drive STOP, START, FORWARD, REWIND, and RECORD from a known STOP state with no image, read-only image, and writable image. Each accepted mode and tape-sense transition matches pinned VICE. No-image RECORD and read-only-image RECORD leave mode and sense unchanged; accepted RECORD with writable media asserts sense.

For identical accepted tape-sense transitions, C64 CPU port $0001 input bit 4 and VIC-20 VIA1 port A input bit 6 match pinned VICE, including input/output direction masking. C64 CIA1 FLAG and VIC-20 VIA2 CA1 pulse events are tested separately and are not substituted for tape-sense input.

With an initially stopped motor and no pending datasette alarm, a motor-on transition schedules the startup read alarm at the current emulated clock plus 32000. The ordered read-side event trace immediately before, at, and after that deadline matches pinned VICE. A pre-existing pending alarm is preserved as VICE preserves it; metadata retrieval alone is not counted as a pulse event.

For a running motor, motor-off schedules stopping at current clock plus 32000 without stopping immediately. Motor-on before that stop executes cancels the pending stop without imposing a new startup ramp. Repeated motor-off does not extend an existing stop deadline. Ordered boundary events and restart after an executed stop match pinned VICE.

Recording writes occur only under the native combination of an attached image, accepted RECORD mode, running motor, and qualifying write-line transition. No image, read-only media that rejected RECORD, wrong mode, motor stopped, repeated levels, and nonqualifying transitions produce the same absence of tape writes as pinned VICE.

For identical accepted recording signal traces and media, emitted TAP bytes, elapsed-gap/remainder handling, first-write state, image-position updates, and failure/STOP side effects match pinned VICE. Cover short and long gap boundaries and partial or failed writes; an incremented managed pulse-buffer count alone does not satisfy this criterion.
Recording mode captures all external input events with their precise frame and cycle timestamps.
Playback mode loads a base snapshot and replays the recorded input events.
Playback produces bit-exact results: the same memory contents, same VIC-II output, same audio output as the original recording at every point.
The replay format stores: base snapshot reference, input event stream (event type, frame number, cycle within frame, value).
Replay can be paused, single-stepped, and fast-forwarded.
The `IReplayEngine` interface provides record/playback/seek operations.
Replay files are compact (only input events are stored, not full state per frame).
Seeking to an arbitrary frame is supported via periodic auto-snapshots during recording.
Each pulse from the tape triggers the FLAG input on CIA1 (directly connected to the cassette read line).
The time between pulses is measured by CIA1 Timer A and/or by CIA1 FLAG interrupts.
Standard Commodore encoding uses three pulse widths: short (352 cycles TAP value $30), medium (512 cycles TAP value $42), and long (672 cycles TAP value $56).
The standard Commodore tape header (FOUND marker), data blocks, and checksums are readable.
Tape reading at normal speed produces identical results to real hardware.
The timing accuracy supports both PAL and NTSC system clock rates.
Turbo loaders using shorter pulse widths than standard (down to approximately 160 cycles per pulse) function correctly.
Common turbo formats (Novaload, Biturbo, Turbotape, Cyberload, Pavloda) load successfully.
Custom pulse encoding schemes are supported through accurate pulse-level emulation.
The CIA FLAG input timing is accurate to 1 system clock cycle.
Half-wave and full-wave detection methods both work correctly.
Multi-speed loaders (that change pulse rates mid-load) are supported.

currentRequirements.note: Projection read is requirements context, not metadata preservation proof or approval of pending field delta.

objectInspection.limitations: Read-only inspection of one retained Windows object. This does not prove its build provenance, final-link interception, runtime observation, or equivalent symbols on other platforms.

notSerializedByTheseWriters: FILE stream direction and error/eof state
serializedFieldCoverage.rtcTrain: pcf8583 register_train[180] is process-static, read by READ_REGS_TRAIN and neither saved nor rebuilt by the inspected snapshot read function. Snapshot fields include clock_regs_for_read, but their presence alone does not establish train restoration.

fixtureDiscovery.nameCommand: rg -n -i novaload|biturbo|turbotape|cyberload|pavloda tests src --glob *.cs (pattern passed as one quoted argument)
fixtureDiscovery.limits: File-name and C# name search only. Archives, excluded native/build/output trees, generated temporary fixture bytes and external corpora were not inspected. No universal absence claim.

capabilities.currentEvidence: Current external clock wrapper calls real vic_cycle then emits maincpu_clk only; diagnostic adapter emits VICE_GATE and VICE_GATE_STOP.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Extend separate external observation tooling only after its approved mock gate. Never synthesize tape events from elapsed clocks.
capabilities.requiredProof: Same-cycle total event order, both machines, complete capture, all-device pause behavior and real bindings are unproved.

capabilities.need: Alarm scheduling, cancellation and pending deadline
capabilities.currentEvidence: alarm_set and dispatch are inline static; inspected datasette.o has zero alarm_set undefined symbols/relocations. alarm_new and alarm_unset are external.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Candidate read-only alarm_new return-pointer capture, keyed by maincpu context, name and original port data; sample native pending queue at approved boundaries. Forward original callback/data unchanged. Never replace callback or mutate native structures.
capabilities.requiredProof: Bounds/lifetime/ABI and call coverage must be proven. Queue samples are not a complete transient schedule trace. Missing same-boundary transitions remains an explicit blocker, not inferred history.

capabilities.currentEvidence: DATASETTE/TAPE writers contain 18/13 named fields. Existing IViceNative has VSF load/save but no explicit tape observer.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Use actual native VSF as canonical snapshot and independently parse native module bytes, preserving module order/port context. Do not infer absent module as zero.
capabilities.requiredProof: Schema/version/truncation/clock-width tests, multiport occurrence identity and real save/load are mandatory. Snapshot call effects need separate proof before observation use.

capabilities.need: Observer does not alter the tape recording precondition
capabilities.currentEvidence: TAPIMAGE writer calls ftell, fseek, fread and fseek restore. C64 shim passes save_disks=0, VIC20 passes 1; both native writers pass save_disks to tapeport.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Separate pristine recording runs from snapshot checkpoints; reproduce full prelude independently. Prefer pass-through call tracing at already-existing I/O calls where validated, without extra fseek/fflush/read.
capabilities.requiredProof: Compare observed and unobserved same-prelude traces; preserve CRT stream direction/errors, physical and logical cursor distinctions. Same final file offset alone is insufficient.

capabilities.currentEvidence: Native snapshot calls sound_snapshot_prepare; C64 also executes drive CPUs to maincpu_clk. sound_snapshot_prepare calls sound_run_sound.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Model snapshot invocation as an explicit native operation in replay fixtures, not a neutral getter. Preserve required VSF round-trip/cross-load gates.
capabilities.requiredProof: Pre/post sound and drive observations plus control runs; no claim that excluding embedded images removes all snapshot effects.

capabilities.need: Write edge, wobble, azimuth and lifecycle process history
capabilities.currentEvidence: last_write_bit initialized -1 and stored across edges; wobble phase/restf and azimuth resterror are static and absent from the named module writers.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Separate fresh process, reset, reattach, resource toggle and VSF-reload histories; pin full setup including attachment scan. Non-neutral fixtures remain mandatory.
capabilities.requiredProof: Actual native history-dependent response and RNG inputs/order. No invented state injection or replacing defaults with neutral settings for the whole suite.

capabilities.need: Datasette sound ring and output phase
capabilities.currentEvidence: Sound ring length 200, indices, startclock, square sign and split state are static. Flush disables chip and sets end=start only.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Observe native gap-enqueue boundary plus actual PCM at native mixer boundary with pinned sample budget/backend/format. Treat gap trace and PCM trace as separate obligations.
capabilities.requiredProof: A gap observer does not establish audio. Ring wrap, partial consumption, split pulse, disable/re-enable and snapshot synchronization require real PCM traces.

capabilities.need: Tape RTC host inputs and shifted serial train
capabilities.currentEvidence: RTC loads persistent context; halted seconds still read host centiseconds. Shared register_train is neither saved nor rebuilt by snapshot reader; CPClockF83 uses read_bit_shift=2.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Pin persistence/timezone, capture all existing time/centisecond inputs and serial line transitions. Compare fresh-process restore and same-process restore before and after a new I2C start.
capabilities.requiredProof: Wrapper control/capture of external inputs and phase-correct train behavior remain unproved. Do not change host clock or native state; deterministic fixture bindings alone are not native runtime proof.

capabilities.need: Recorded tape bytes and partial I/O
capabilities.currentEvidence: Retained object has external fread/fwrite/fseek relocations; current clock observer records none of them.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Candidate pass-through wrappers preserve arguments, call count/order, results and native error state. Identify tape stream without fabricating logical positions. Capture actual post-run bytes independently.
capabilities.requiredProof: Final-link interception, errno/error/eof preservation, short-write/failure behavior and platform behavior must be validated. Never count metadata pulse buffers as file evidence.

capabilities.currentEvidence: Bounded search found 15 candidate media paths, zero TAP/T64; loader names absent from src/tests C#.
capabilities.proposedRoute: Retain all five named success obligations. Build corpus manifest with bytes/hash/license or provenance, machine/timing, launch prelude, native success signal and expected payload/entry state.
capabilities.requiredProof: Five real independent success fixtures, custom encoding, rate changes, half/full waves and sub/at/above-160 cases missing. Failure equality cannot pass successful-load AC.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: A clock-only response reports tape capability unavailable. A proposed tape response must identify source, machine, port, clock, ordinal, event, value and observation boundary; missing data fails admission.
negativeControls: Clock-only response claims tape trace complete
Missing event accepted because clock advanced
Two same-clock events reversed or collapsed
Invented zero fills an unavailable state
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Actual native tape callbacks captured under approved observer and identical fixture assertions.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Forward alarm_new exactly once with original context, name, callback and data; retain returned pointer only for read-only inspection. Separate the two Datasette alarms by port data, never by equal name alone; reject invalid pending index before dereference.
negativeControls: Both ports share one identity
Callback or data replaced
Extra alarm_new call
Pending index outside native queue accepted
Freed alarm pointer retained
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Real external link call capture and ABI/lifetime validation; not yet implemented.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Distinguish sampled queue states from full scheduling-event coverage. If set/change/unset occurs between observation boundaries, incomplete event coverage cannot satisfy full trace assertions.
negativeControls: No alarm_set import interpreted as no scheduling
alarm_unset events accepted as complete history
Final pending deadline used to infer all prior schedules
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Approved observer must capture transient same-boundary changes or leave the case explicitly blocked.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Validate module name/version/payload length and ordered occurrences against independent VSF fixtures; preserve all 18 DATASETTE and 13 TAPE fields and port context. No-image module absence differs from numeric zero state.
negativeControls: Missing DATASETTE becomes zero motor
TAPE current_file_seek_position reported as physical FILE position
Two port module instances collapsed
Truncated field accepted
last_write_bit fabricated from last_write_clk
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Native-authored VSF bytes plus cross-load and round-trip receipts, not only parser tests.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Use existing Recording_FileCursor_CommandOrder prelude. Capture the original ordered I/O operations without adding a stream operation between native read and write; run snapshot checkpoints in independent same-prelude executions.
negativeControls: Inserted fseek restore considered neutral
Inserted fflush hidden
Returned count changed
errno/error/eof state overwritten by logger
Logical position substituted for physical output offset
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Real CRT traces and post-run bytes, with no-observer control; platform differences retained.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Fixtures distinguish C64 shim save_disks=0 and VIC20 save_disks=1, and include native sound preparation plus C64 drive synchronization. Snapshot occurrence is an explicit workload event.
negativeControls: Both machine snapshot modes treated equal
No embedded image assumed to mean no state effects
Capture calls omitted from replay history
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Before/after native sound/drive/media state and matching control run; native VSF remains mandatory.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Use separate fresh-process and same-process reset/reattach/VSF load preludes. Preserve write-bit history and non-neutral wobble/azimuth state; only neutral timing subfixtures disable those resources.
negativeControls: Reset clears last_write_bit without native evidence
VSF equality asserted to prove hidden static equality
Every case forces neutral resources
RNG calls reordered
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Native traces for actual histories; no direct private-state writes or inferred responses.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Correct scripted traces distinguish enqueue from PCM and preserve ring wrap, split consumption, retained sign/split state after flush, selected float/int backend and exact sample budget.
negativeControls: Gap enqueue accepted as audio proof
Flush resets square sign
Ring wrap drops wrong gap
Snapshot sound-run omitted
Sample budget or backend changed
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Native PCM observations on both sides of snapshot/disable/ring boundaries; gap-only capture cannot pass.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Pin fresh/existing persistent context and timezone; log seconds and centisecond inputs independently even with clock_halt. Restore in fresh and same process during READ_REGS_TRAIN, then after new I2C start; compare native serial bit sequence at each phase.
negativeControls: clock_halt assumed to freeze centiseconds
Old persistent context ignored
register_train reconstructed on load without native evidence
Same-process prelude omitted
Host clock changed to force equality
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Actual native host-input and serial traces. Candidate mocks exercise assertions but do not establish native controllability.

fixtureGroups.positiveContract: Require one identified successful native workload for each Novaload, Biturbo, Turbotape, Cyberload and Pavloda case; verify resulting payload/entry state and precise event trace alongside rate/encoding cases.
negativeControls: Both emulators fail and case passes
Loader label has no pinned bytes
Native success inferred from timeout absence
Disk fixture renamed to satisfy tape corpus
Missing loader silently skipped
fixtureGroups.realBindingProof: Five real retained success receipts plus custom/rate/half-wave timing cases; discovery is not execution.
